title: 3.12 Have, Has, Mine, Yours, and Ours
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
sub_lesson_title: Have, Has, Mine, Yours, and Ours
goal: Say who has familiar objects and distinguish mine, yours and ours.
grammar_function: He/she has; I/you/we/they have. This car is mine. This book is yours. That house is ours. Is this phone yours?
prerequisite: 3.10-3.11 possessives, 3.4 yes/no questions, Unit 2 objects, plurals and colors.
speaking_outcome: Name the object and its owner, and answer Is this phone yours? with Yes, this phone is mine.
